title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
native_title: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険
source: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure manga by Hirohiko Araki, Part 1 (Phantom Blood) and Part 3 (Stardust Crusaders), both finished. Later parts are not used.
world: Dio Brando, adopted into the Joestar family in Victorian England, uses an ancient stone mask to become a vampire and fights Jonathan Joestar. A century later DIO rises again in Jonathan's body and rules from Cairo, and Jotaro Kujo, Joseph Joestar and their allies travel from Japan to Egypt to stop him. Over-the-top poses, strange powers and bold style.
power_system: Part 1 uses the stone mask (vampires) and Hamon (Ripple), a breathing energy. Part 3 introduces Stands, visible spirits with unique powers that only Stand users can see. DIO's Stand, The World, can stop time.

groups.name: Stardust Crusaders
groups.line: Jotaro, Joseph, Avdol, Kakyoin, Polnareff and Iggy.

groups.name: DIO's followers
groups.line: Stand users serving DIO, like Vanilla Ice and Enya.

terms.line: A visible spirit with a special power.
Aztec mask that turns people into vampires.
Sunlight-like breathing energy that destroys vampires.

timeline.summary: Dio becomes a vampire; Jonathan defeats him; Dio's head takes Jonathan's body.
DIO awakens; the Crusaders travel to Egypt; Jotaro defeats DIO in Cairo.
